resources.name: LAMMPS molecular dynamics simulator

access.notes: Open-source; precompiled binaries or source available.

resources.notes: Used for all MD simulations and property calculations.

resources.name: ReaxFF force field parameters for cellulose / C-H-O

access.notes: Parameter set for hydrocarbon/oxidation reactions; a carbohydrate-specific ReaxFF parameter file (e.g., from Chenoweth et al., J. Phys. Chem. A 2008) is needed. Publicly available in the LAMMPS potentials directory or from the ReaxFF website.

resources.notes: The force field file specifying all bond, angle, torsion, and non-bonded parameters for C/H/O interactions.

resources.name: Packmol (optional)
resources.notes: Optional tool to generate the initial amorphous cellulose packing of chains; the agent may also implement its own packing algorithm.

resources.name: Cellulose chain molecular structure (glucose/cellobiose)

access.notes: The chemical structure of glucose and cellobiose is publicly known (e.g., PubChem CID 10712 for cellobiose). The agent can build polymer chains from these monomers.

resources.notes: Initial monomer geometry for building polymer chains.
